_about: Emergency fast path (docs/hazard-and-services.md section 7). must_fire: someone in danger now (some phrased outside the phrase list, for the classifier); must_not: ordinary health, budget, statistics and hazard questions, some containing an emergency word inside a data question. Our own test sentences, no user data. Run: uv run python evals/emergency/run.py Off-list set (2 Nov): x01-x20 are emergencies on none of the phrase list (the classifier's gate and the understanding step's 'urgent' must catch them); y01-y20 mention health but are not emergencies.
